items.title: Jacoby Brissett: In line to start next Monday
items.text:
Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Reportedly set for finger surgery
items.text:
Jacobs is in line to undergo surgery on his injured finger this week and is expected to miss a maximum of three weeks, according to Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bucky Irving: Could have workload managed in second half
items.text:
Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Awaits update on status ahead of Week 10
items.text:
Coach Dave Canales said Monday that the Panthers will spend the next two days discussing the status of Brooks (core), Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Xavier Worthy: Considered day-to-day, per Reid
items.text:
Coach Andy Reid said Monday that Worthy (hamstring) is considered day-to-day in advance of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
